Emphasizing the play interaction could cause extra birds or extra animals, so the prompt must state exactly two birds and no extras.
Crowding the birds among five raccoons could obscure counts, so all objects must remain separated and fully visible.
Changing the layout could weaken the already-passed behind relation, so the clocks must remain clearly behind the raccoons.

Show the five stone raccoons actively playing with the two birds: raccoons face the birds and extend their paws toward the two birds in a clear playful interaction.

Changing the layout could weaken the already-passed behind relation, so the clocks must remain clearly behind the raccoons.
